name: bug-hunt
context_rationale: Orchestrator: risk-ranks the codebase, holds the work-list in memory, runs the sequential finder Agent-spawn loop, invokes write_pass.py / finding_dedup.py / assemble.py between subagents, spawns code-review refuters, and makes the interactive (declinable) /repro+/slice handoff offers — all requiring the parent conversation's tool access and cwd.
summary: Whole-codebase correctness + security defect sweep. Risk-ranks the riskiest code via code-review-graph, fans out intent-aware finder subagents along the code-review 9 dimensions (multi-finder, not one-shot), de-duplicates across finders via the shared finding_dedup, then adversarially verifies every candidate with code-review refuters (majority vote for high/critical) so confirmed bugs survive and false positives are killed. Fills the whole-codebase DEFECT cell that /diagnose (structural) and /code-review (diff-scoped) leave empty. Emits bug-hunt-out/findings.json (+ optional --report diagnosis.html via the shared assemble.py) and offers a declinable /repro -> /slice handoff for confirmed bugs. Never modifies source files.

reads.purpose: Read by assemble.py to carry over prior Confirmed/Notes annotations (--report re-runs)

outputs.purpose: Root output directory for all bug-hunt artifacts
Code graph for risk-ranking and finder cross-checks — ALWAYS built fresh (never reuses a prior /diagnose graph; stale reachability would mis-rank risk)
Risk-ranked work-list partitioned into K finder buckets; records the un-reviewed tail
Raw finder subagent response saved before write_pass.py
Per-bucket structured findings (correctness-bug / security categories); input to finding_dedup and the refute gate
Default deliverable: the verified, merged finding list (same finding schema as /diagnose)
Optional owner-facing HTML report (--report) produced by the shared assemble.py
On an accepted handoff, append a confirmed bug as a slice candidate (source type bug-hunt-finding)

agents.name: code-review
agents.when: Step 7 — adversarial verification of each merged candidate finding
agents.purpose: Refuter persona: reads the cited code and votes real|not-real|uncertain (defaulting to not-real when it cannot reproduce the failing path); 3 refuters + majority for high/critical, single refuter for medium/low. The same code-Critic persona reused as the finder lens.

tools.name: finding_dedup
tools.purpose: Cross-finder de-duplication: collapse findings sharing a code location (path + line span) into one F-MRG-* finding carrying merged_ids/seen_by_passes/categories. Shared with /diagnose (assemble.py).

tools.name: write_pass
tools.purpose: Orchestrator-side writer: parse each finder subagent's fenced section/findings/summary blocks, normalize + validate findings, write the three per-bucket files. SHARED in scripts/lib/ (same module /diagnose uses).

tools.name: assemble
tools.purpose: Render the optional owner-facing HTML report from the verified findings (only under --report). SHARED in scripts/lib/ (same module /diagnose uses); already runs the shared finding_dedup internally.

tools.name: vault_edit
tools.purpose: SVW-1 safe append of an accepted bug finding into <vault>/candidates.json (source type bug-hunt-finding) on a declinable /repro+/slice handoff.

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.invocation: code-review-graph build | CRG MCP tools (impact-radius, review-context, search)
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — ALWAYS built fresh per run for risk-ranking (centrality/blast-radius) and finder cross-checks; never reuses a prior /diagnose graph (stale reachability would mis-rank risk).
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Run code-review-graph build, risk-ranking queries, write_pass.py, finding_dedup.py, assemble.py, vault_edit.py

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Read source files within TARGET; read docstrings/tests/README as intent HYPOTHESES (proven against code, never trusted)

harness_tools.name: Glob
harness_tools.purpose: Build the file work-list; verify per-bucket output files exist

harness_tools.name: Grep
harness_tools.purpose: Locate sinks (SQL/exec/shell), auth/permission checks, deserializers for the risk-ranked work-list

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Write the risk-ranked worklist.json and each finder's raw response to $OUT/.tmp/ before write_pass.py

harness_tools.name: Agent
harness_tools.purpose: Spawn the general-purpose finder subagents (multi-finder fan-out, analysis-pass) and the code-review refuter subagents for adversarial verification

harness_tools.name: WebSearch
harness_tools.purpose: Dimension-8 web-known-issues checks during finding (known-bad API patterns, deprecations, quotas)

source: skills/bug-hunt/SKILL.md (new in v2 — no v1 reference; complements /diagnose + /code-review)
